root_cause_label: Built Cython Extensions for Wrong Python Interpreter (ABI Mismatch)
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent compiled and installed all Cython extensions using the system Python 3.13 interpreter (/usr/local/bin/python3) rather than the task-evaluation interpreter (Python 3.12 venv), so all .so files are tagged cpython-313 and cannot be loaded by the evaluator, resulting in failure despite the agent self-verifying success using the wrong interpreter.
t_err_evidence: Step 21: agent runs '/usr/local/bin/python3 setup.py build_ext --inplace', which successfully compiles four Cython extensions tagged 'cpython-313' (e.g., 'chelpers.cpython-313-x86_64-linux-gnu.so'). The agent discovered at step 11 that the active runtime was /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python3 (Python 3.12) but never addressed this; it chose /usr/local/bin/python3 (Python 3.13) as the build interpreter and stuck with it for all subsequent install/verify steps.
t_commit_evidence: Step 21 is also t_commit: once the build produces cpython-313 artifacts and the agent shifts to a purely Python-3.13-based install+verify loop (steps 22, 28, 34, 51, 54, 59), recovery would require completely rebuilding with the correct interpreter. The agent never attempts this, so the outcome is locked from step 21 onward.
trigger_explanation: After diagnosing at steps 10-19 that Cython was missing from the active venv (Python 3.12) and that /usr/local/bin/python3 (Python 3.13) had both Cython and NumPy, the agent acted on the false premise that the evaluator would use /usr/local/bin/python3. It never verified which Python interpreter the task harness actually invokes, so it built against the wrong ABI. All subsequent source-level fixes (numpy alias replacements, fractions.gcd, periodicline syntax) were correct but irrelevant to the actual failure.
forewarning_evidence: Step 9: build_ext silently skipped Cython because 'Cython or numpy could not be imported' (the venv lacked Cython). Steps 10-16: repeated ModuleNotFoundError for Cython in /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python3, indicating the active interpreter differs from where the agent installed Cython. Step 21 output: all compiled .so files carry 'cpython-313' ABI tags, a visible signal that the artifacts are for Python 3.13, not the Python 3.12 venv.
